reviews.author: Big P
reviews.text: Broke down on Hwy 220 N, in Ellerbe, NC... searched for diesel repair company..only 2 listed. Then I searched for heavy duty towing..only 2 listed!! Called the one closest to me and good lord!!! These ppl love their g's!!! Hit up Ole boy at shop #2, and he was talking my language. Boys at da burger place must be creepn on ere'body bc they was $300 higher than these R'ham boys!!! I called Watson wrecker and ain't regretted it yet.. I thought id need to be towed. Instead of making them Benjamins off of me, he said he thought he cld fix it roadside...and DID THE DAMN THING!!! Awesome company my ppl...give them a ring..wonderful service..HONEST.. not out for just the dollar..not like dem boys in Hoffman.. they must be trying to charge enuf to pay for dem clean trucks.. a clean truck ain't a working truck and we all know that!

reviews.author: mike Y
reviews.text: Had another local tow company tow my box truck to a repair shop and they all but tore it up. Pinched my hydraulic lines and how it didnt break them, ill nvr know. They advertised always the best and do the work 'right'. I can tell u.now...thats not true! Not to mention their prices. Called this company to transport it to Charlotte Nc, and im 100% pleased. Communicated well with me when they were on the way and no further damage to my truck. Don't go with the ones that claim they are the best...go with the companies who are too busy working to make so many.posts claiming they are the best. Ill take experience over '#1 or #2', any day!! Thank you Russ, for looking out for us.

reviews.author: Mary Monroe
reviews.text: Awesome service!!! Towed my truck for me on a moments notice!!! Quick and professional!!! Largest towing company in the area and def who the locals use!!! Been in business the longest of the few tow companies in the area... Def has the most experience !!!! Save their number in case you ever need them!!!
